guarantees.claim: For each alert index i, the prim_alert_sender instance receives the same alert request source alerts[0] (not alerts[i]).
The alert_ack_o and alert_state_o outputs of each prim_alert_sender are left unconnected within the hmac module.
Each instance i uses AlertAsyncOn[i] for the AsyncOn parameter and AlertIsFatal[i] for the IsFatal parameter, creating per-alert configuration.

assumptions.claim: External logic must drive alert_rx_i[i] for each i according to the prim_alert_sender protocol to complete the alert handshake.
assumptions.risk: If alert_rx_i is not properly driven, the alert sender may stall or behave incorrectly.

assumptions.claim: alerts[0] must correctly represent the alert request for all instances because it is shared across all i.
assumptions.risk: If alerts[0] does not reflect the intended per-instance alert condition, alerts may be missed or incorrectly triggered.

assumptions.claim: The prim_alert_sender module must tolerate unconnected alert_ack_o and alert_state_o without protocol violation.
assumptions.risk: If the primitive expects these outputs to be observed for state updates, leaving them unconnected may cause internal state machine hang.

uncertain_points.claim: The generate loop connects all alert_req_i to alerts[0] instead of alerts[i]; it is unclear whether this is a bug or an intentional single-alert-source design.
uncertain_points.risk: If alerts is a multi-bit bus with per-alert sources, this connection may mask or misroute individual alert requests.

uncertain_points.claim: alert_ack_o and alert_state_o are unconnected, so the HMAC has no visibility into alert acknowledgement or current state.
uncertain_points.risk: If the alert protocol requires acknowledgement tracking or state monitoring for error handling, this omission could lead to undetected alert loss or incorrect system state.

uncertain_points.claim: The alert_rx_i[i] signals are driven by an external alert receiver; the protocol compatibility and timing between the HMAC and that receiver must be verified.
uncertain_points.risk: Protocol mismatch or incorrect integration could cause alert delivery failure.
